user.title: Add a Wellfed feeder
user.description: Reach the feeder directly, as a client of its own, or through your Wellfed server. The entities are the same either way, and you can switch later.

direct.title: Pair a Wellfed feeder
direct.description: Make a member invite on a paired client (`wellfed invite --role member`, or People in the app) and paste it here within 10 minutes. Home Assistant joins as its own client, as a member: it can feed, change the settings, the lock, the plans and the portion weight, and read everything. It needs no server.

data_description.address: The feeder's IP address. Leave empty to find it on the network.

server.title: Sign in to your Wellfed server
server.description: Home Assistant reaches the feeder through the server, as the account you sign in with: an owner or a member. A viewer account cannot be used, since it changes nothing.

data_description.url: Where the Wellfed server answers, such as `https://wellfed.example.com`. An `http://` address sends the password and Home Assistant's token unencrypted, so use it only on a network you trust; Home Assistant asks you to confirm one.
data_description.username: The name of an owner or member account on the server.
data_description.password: Used once, to sign in. Home Assistant keeps a token of its own instead, which the server lists as home-assistant.

plain_http.title: Use an unencrypted address?
plain_http.description: {url} is plain `http://`: the password you sign in with, and the token Home Assistant keeps, cross your network unencrypted, where anyone on it can read them. Use an `https://` address if the server has one. Continue only if you trust every device on this network.

server_feeder.title: Choose the feeder
server_feeder.description: The feeders on the server that Home Assistant does not have yet. Add each one as its own entry.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Pair the feeder at {address}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Make a member invite on a paired client (`wellfed invite --role member`, or People in the app) and paste it here within 10 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair the feeder again
reauth_confirm.description: The feeder no longer knows this Home Assistant: its key was removed. Make a new member invite on a paired client and paste it here. Home Assistant joins with a new key.

reauth_server.title: Sign in to the Wellfed server again
reauth_server.description: The server at {url} no longer takes Home Assistant's token: it was revoked or expired, or the account was disabled. Sign in again, and Home Assistant gets a new token.

reconfigure.title: Change how the feeder is reached

menu_options.reconfigure_server: Reach it through a Wellfed server
menu_options.reconfigure_direct: Reach it directly, with a member invite

reconfigure_address.title: Feeder address
reconfigure_address.description: Where Home Assistant finds the feeder.

data_description.address: The feeder's IP address. Leave empty to find it on the network.

reconfigure_server.title: Reach the feeder through a Wellfed server
reconfigure_server.description: Sign in to the server that holds this feeder. The entities and their history stay as they are. A key Home Assistant held on the feeder directly is removed if the server can remove it; otherwise Home Assistant asks you to remove it in the app.

data_description.url: Where the Wellfed server answers, such as `https://wellfed.example.com`. An `http://` address sends the password and Home Assistant's token unencrypted, so use it only on a network you trust; Home Assistant asks you to confirm one.
data_description.username: The name of an owner or member account on the server.
data_description.password: Used once, to sign in. Home Assistant keeps a token of its own instead, which the server lists as home-assistant.

reconfigure_direct.title: Reach the feeder directly
reconfigure_direct.description: Make a member invite for this feeder on a paired client and paste it here. The entities and their history stay as they are, and Home Assistant revokes its token on the server.

data_description.address: The feeder's IP address. Leave empty to find it on the network.

error.invalid_invite: That is not a Wellfed invite.
error.join_unreachable: Home Assistant could not reach the feeder, or it did not answer, so nothing was joined. Check the address and that the feeder is on, then try again.
error.join_not_accepted: The feeder did not accept the invite. It may have expired or been used already, so make a new one.
error.join_uncertain: The feeder took the invite, but its answer was lost and Home Assistant could not check whether it joined. Submit again: Home Assistant asks the feeder first, and needs a new invite only if it did not join.
error.join_failed: Joining the feeder failed. Try again.
error.wrong_feeder: That invite is for a different feeder.
error.not_member_invite: That invite gives more than a member's rights. Home Assistant joins only as a member, so it removed the key it was given. Make a member invite instead.
error.not_member_invite_kept: That invite gives more than a member's rights, and Home Assistant could not remove the key it was given. Remove the client named home-assistant from the feeder (People in the app, or `wellfed revoke`), then make a member invite.
error.server_unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check it, and that the server is running.
error.server_not_a_server: That address does not answer as a Wellfed server.
error.server_redirected: That address redirects elsewhere. Use the address it redirects to.
error.server_bad_credentials: The name or password is wrong.
error.server_login_limited: Too many failed sign-ins. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.server_account_disabled: That account is past its expiry. An owner can renew it.
error.server_unauthorized: The server did not accept the sign-in. Try again.
error.server_forbidden: That account may not change anything (a viewer). Use an owner or member account.
error.server_refused: The server refused. Check its log, then try again.
error.not_on_server: That server does not hold this feeder. Adopt it on the server first.

abort.not_a_feeder: That device does not look like a Wellfed feeder.
abort.no_feeders: The server holds no feeder that Home Assistant does not have yet. Adopt one on the server first.
abort.pair_again: This entry is from an earlier test build of the integration. Delete it and pair the feeder again.

state.newer_build: Unknown to this integration: update it
Unknown to this integration: update it

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Dispense portions now. Sent once: a feed whose answer is lost is reported, never retried.

cancel_feed.name: Cancel feed
cancel_feed.description: Stop a running feed. Without a number, the feed Home Assistant started.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: The feeder's number for the feed.

write_uncertain.message: The feeder did not answer, so it may have run. It was not sent again: the feeding history will show whether it did.

not_a_feeder.message: That device is not a Wellfed feeder.

no_feed.message: No feed from Home Assistant is running to cancel.

revoked.message: The feeder no longer knows this Home Assistant. Pair it again.

not_ready.message: The feeder did not answer. Home Assistant will try again.

not_sent_disconnected.message: Not sent: the feeder is not connected. Nothing reached it, so you can try again.

not_sent_stopped.message: Not sent: this feeder's session has stopped. Reload the integration, or pair it again if it was removed.

not_sent_busy.message: Not sent: a change to the same settings is still waiting on the feeder. Try again in a moment.

not_sent_forbidden.message: Not sent: this client's role may not do that.

not_sent_unsupported.message: Not sent: the feeder's firmware does not support this.

not_sent_not_read.message: Not sent: Home Assistant has not read the feeder's settings yet. Try again in a moment.

not_sent_invalid.message: Not sent: that value is outside what the feeder accepts.

not_sent_held.message: Not sent: another feed is still being answered or settled, so this one waits. Home Assistant settles it within 15 minutes; check the bowl before feeding again.

refused_forbidden.message: The feeder refused: this client's role may not do that.

refused_stale.message: The feeder refused: the settings changed meanwhile. Home Assistant read them again; check and try again.

refused_busy.message: The feeder refused: it is busy. Try again in a moment.

refused_unavailable.message: The feeder refused: this firmware does not serve that.

refused_invalid.message: The feeder refused: a value failed its checks.

refused_not_writable.message: The feeder refused: its storage cannot be written now.

refused_full.message: The feeder refused: it is full.

refused_not_found.message: The feeder refused: there is no such feed or plan.

refused_muted.message: The feeder refused: its sound is off or outside its sound window.

refused_fault.message: The feeder refused: it stopped on a fault and feeds again after a restart.

refused_unverified.message: The feeder refused: that bowl mode is not verified on this feeder.

refused_portions.message: The feeder refused: a feed is 1 to 48 portions.

refused_no_clock.message: The feeder refused: its clock is not set yet.

refused_newer_build.message: The feeder refused it for a reason this integration does not know, from a newer feeder build. Update the integration to see why.

token_refused.message: The Wellfed server no longer takes Home Assistant's token. Sign in again.

bad_entry.message: This entry's settings are not valid. Remove it and add the feeder again.

not_sent_legacy.message: Not sent: the feeder runs firmware from before this integration's device API. Update it from the Wellfed app.

uncertain_feed.title: A feed on feeder {feeder} may have run
uncertain_feed.description: Home Assistant sent a feed and no answer came, so it may have run. It was not sent again. This clears itself once the feeder's history shows the feed. Check the bowl before feeding again.

unknown_feed.title: Whether a feed on feeder {feeder} ran is not known
unknown_feed.description: Home Assistant sent a feed of {portions} portions and no answer came, and the feeder's history holds no record of it yet. It may have run without being recorded, or never reached the feeder. Check the bowl, then ignore this. Home Assistant feeds again meanwhile, and if the feed's record turns up within a week, this clears itself.

update_feeder.title: Feeder {feeder} runs older firmware
update_feeder.description: Feeder {feeder} runs build {build}, older than this integration expects. Everything both know works; what the feeder lacks is refused. Update the feeder from the Wellfed app. This clears once it runs a newer build.

update_integration.title: Update the Wellfed integration for feeder {feeder}
update_integration.description: Feeder {feeder} runs build {build}, newer than this integration. Everything both know works; what the newer build added shows as unknown. Update the Wellfed integration. This clears once it matches.

legacy_feeder.title: Feeder {feeder} needs a firmware update
legacy_feeder.description: Feeder {feeder} runs build {build}, from before this integration's device API, so Home Assistant can read and change nothing on it and its entities are unavailable. Update the feeder from the Wellfed app. Home Assistant tries again on its own, and this clears once it answers.

update_server.title: Update the Wellfed server for feeder {feeder}
update_server.description: The Wellfed server that Home Assistant reaches feeder {feeder} through (build {build}) is older than the feeder or this integration. Everything all three know works; what the server lacks is refused or shows as unknown. Update the server. This clears once it matches.

server_lost_feeder.title: The Wellfed server no longer reaches feeder {feeder}
server_lost_feeder.description: The server no longer holds feeder {feeder}: it was removed from the server, or the feeder dropped the server's key. Adopt the feeder on the server again. Home Assistant checks every few minutes, and this clears once it reaches the feeder.

leftover_key.title: Remove Home Assistant's old key from feeder {feeder}
leftover_key.description: Home Assistant could not remove a key it used before to reach feeder {feeder} (the key starts {key}), so the feeder may still list it. Remove it: the client named home-assistant whose key starts {key}, in the feeder's people in the app or with `wellfed revoke {key}`. Its key differs from the one Home Assistant uses now. This clears once the feeder no longer lists it.

leftover_key_left.title: Remove Home Assistant's old key from feeder {feeder}
leftover_key_left.description: A Wellfed entry was deleted while feeder {feeder} may still list a key Home Assistant used before (the key starts {key}), and nothing checks it now. Remove the client named home-assistant whose key starts {key}, in the feeder's people in the app or with `wellfed revoke {key}`, then ignore this.

token_left.title: Revoke Home Assistant's token on the Wellfed server
token_left.description: A Wellfed entry was deleted, but the server at {url} could not be reached to revoke the token Home Assistant used. The token still works until it is revoked. Revoke it in the app or with the Wellfed CLI: its id is {token_id}. Then ignore this.
